metanarrative_source: Georg supplied HyperNorm brief and prior authoring context;canonical remote lore reread deferred as documented in Return;no canon approval inferred

records.name: Rex Respawn
records.biography_en: Rex retries the HyperNorm game until losing begins to feel like a design opinion directed at him. The Men in Black appreciate competitive certainty. A contradictory card suggested that another player was enjoying the same match differently. He still objects, but has started saying well played first.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Defeat has been registered. Acceptance is not installed.

records.name: Pip Pixels
records.biography_en: Pip keeps an old joystick in his HyperNorm room and calls its limitations honest. Hunky and Dory have offered more efficient entertainment. A dissonant card asked him to show a neighbour the old game. He found that explaining the controls was almost as pleasing as using them.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The graphics are simple. His affection requires no upgrade.

records.name: Lottie Loot
records.biography_en: Lottie opens HyperNorm reward boxes with reverence for what they might contain. The Men in Black prefer rewards to questions. An ambiguous card arrived without a rarity marker. She kept it after a neighbour said it mattered to them, though she cannot yet explain its value in the usual way.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The reward is possible. For now that is the reward.

records.name: Sven Speedskip
records.biography_en: Sven optimizes HyperNorm play until every detour becomes an accusation. Hunky and Dory praise improved times. A dissonant card led to a slower route with another player. He kept a note of it, labelled the inefficient route, and returns to it more often than expected.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Time has been saved. Enjoyment was not measured.

records.name: Clyde Dailylogin
records.biography_en: Clyde logs into HyperNorm games because yesterday did, and tomorrow will ask. The Men in Black call this loyalty. A contradictory card suggested that absence need not cancel affection. He missed one evening to bring a neighbour dinner. The streak ended; the neighbour remembered.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: The streak continues. Its original purpose is unavailable.

records.name: Dee Moreplease
records.biography_en: Dee chases the next HyperNorm reward with a gamepad in one hand and a drink in the other. Hunky and Dory applaud her engagement. An ambiguous card offered a pause without a penalty. She tried it while a friend talked and discovered that anticipation was not the only available feeling.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Another round is indicated. The previous pleasure has not settled.
